integrity: Exact rational finite-state checks and a direct enumeration accompany a self-contained mathematical proof; finite checks are not substitutes for the infinite-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary signal accuracy and independent Poisson activation clocks on a star; homogeneous leaf rates, one arbitrary positive hub-rate ratio, initially unannounced public opinions. Fixed-bias and weak-signal asymptotics hold with the rate ratio fixed. A related 2014 star-convergence theorem is credited; specialist priority uncertainty remains. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact error constants and weak-signal crossover for asynchronous learning on stars
